findings.title: No observer-free field remains
findings.claim: As an exploratory spatial echo, the focus hearing-sight pair abolishes the idea that withdrawal, a barrier, or remoteness can place a field beyond perception at arrival.

findings.reader_payoff: The reader can feel the spatial force of the paired exclamations: no private or remote zone remains outside the hearing and sight of the arriving encounter.
findings.containment: This is explicitly exploratory and surprising. The empty-terrain idiom is not a direct gloss of the focus exclamation, and the narrative privacy in 19:16-17 is not morally condemned; the relation is limited to the spatial echo.
